section_1.title: Introduction: What is a Vector?
section_1.content: Define vectors as entities possessing both magnitude and direction, contrasted with scalars (magnitude only). Introduce the coordinate plane representation (x, y).
section_1.example: A GPS-guided drone flying 5km North (vector) versus a drone's battery level at 80% (scalar).

section_2.title: Vector Addition: The Tip-to-Tail Rule
section_2.content: Explain vector addition geometrically. Visualize the result as the diagonal of a parallelogram. Introduce the concept of resultant vectors.
section_2.example: A cat walking 3 meters East, then 4 meters North. The 'resultant' path is the straight-line displacement from the start to the end point.

section_3.title: Scalar Multiplication: Stretching and Flipping
section_3.content: Discuss how multiplying a vector by a scalar changes its length or reverses its direction. Use a scaling factor (k) to show visual compression or expansion.
section_3.example: A game character running at velocity V. If they get a 'Speed Boost' power-up, their velocity becomes 2V (doubling the vector length).

section_4.title: Linear Combinations: Spanning the Space
section_4.content: Explain that any vector in 2D can be reached by a combination of two basis vectors (i and j). Introduce the concept of linear span.
section_4.example: A robotic arm with two joints; by adjusting the lengths (scalars) of its segments (basis vectors), the gripper can reach any point in its reachable workspace.

section_5.title: Summary and Real-world Application
section_5.content: Briefly recap vectors as the building blocks of Linear Algebra. Conclude by mentioning how these concepts form the foundation for 3D graphics and AI neural networks.
section_5.example: Visualizing how pixels on a screen are essentially vectors being transformed and manipulated by matrix operations to render animations.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Summary and Real-world Application", [
            "Vectors are foundational to linear algebra.",
            "They enable 3D graphics and rendering.",
            "Vectors drive modern AI neural networks."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        
        summary_group = VGroup(
            Text("Vectors", color=WHITE),
            Text("Addition", color=WHITE),
            Text("Scaling", color=WHITE),
            Text("Spans", color=WHITE)
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.place_in_area(summary_group, 'A1', 'C6', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(summary_group))

        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight arrow in red
        self.play(vector.animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF0000")
        self.wait(1)
